label: L=3 first copy step (t=4) + weak t=0 a/i/t
explanation: Two disjoint components. (1) Strong: in length-3 sequences only, the step right after <DEL> (t=4, input orig(0), output orig(1)); fires on every such step regardless of token and carries ~79% of activation mass, with all top activations here (~0.7-1.0 of max). (2) Weak: the very first step (t=0) when the first token is a, i or t (~21% of mass; magnitude ordered a (~0.06 of max) > t (~0.04) > i (~0.01)). Never fires at the delimiter, at other original-phase positions, or at copy steps of sequences with L>=4 (except 3 stray t=5 steps). Disjunction gets dev F1 ~1.0.
